 Cargo ship crashes into Tacony-Palmyra Bridge causing it to get stuck open 
 A large cargo ship crashed into the Tacony-Palmyra Bridge on Nov. 12 leading to it becoming stuck open and now traffic can't cross between NJ and Pa. 
 By Emily Rose Grassi • 
 Published 49 minutes ago • 
 Updated 6 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Traffic between Pennsylvania and New Jersey is being disrupted after a large cargo ship crashed into the Tacony-Palmyra Bridge on Thursday, according to Pa. State Rep. Ed Neilson.
 The crash happened on Nov. 12 and now the bridge is unable to close. 
 Stream Philadelphia News for free, 24/7, wherever you are with NBC10.

 Anyone hitting the roads and expecting to drive over the bridge are being urged to find alternate routes. 
 Due to this, congestion and heavier traffic levels on the other bridges between New Jersey and Pennsylvania should be expected. 
 Officials say there have been no reported injuries. 
 Officials haven't said if the crash is weather-related but it happened as severe storms moved through the region. 
 No word yet on when the bridge will be fixed.
